title: Property research tools
intro: Research a location, open the official parcel and title services, and keep your review organized. Use the area converter and checklist here without leaving the dashboard.

access.title: Realtor or Admin access required
access.description: These tools are available to signed-in Realtors and Admins. If your session has expired, sign in again with your authorized account.

site_tools.title: Your website tools
site_tools.description: Find listings on the property map or open the ROI calculator with your own assumptions.

area.title: Area converter
area.intro: Convert between square metres, square feet and hectares.
area.invalid: Enter a finite area of zero or more.
area.formula: Exact conversion factors: 1 ft² = 0.09290304 m²; 1 hectare = 10,000 m². Displayed results are rounded.

directory.title: Official services and research links
directory.distinction: A parcel map helps locate cadastral geometry. Document verification checks an issued document. Current legal status requires the official certificate and appropriate professional review; a map or completed checklist does not establish clear title.
directory.external_note: Official services open in a new tab. Complete any sign-in, security check, document request or payment on the official service. Availability and requirements are set by each institution.
directory.unavailable: Your configured tools could not be loaded. Only the built-in public official links are shown; retry by reopening this page.
directory.configured_note: Review this service's access conditions and current requirements on its website.
directory.empty: No matching resources. Try a different word or category.

checklist.title: Property review checklist
checklist.intro: Use this as a working reminder while reviewing a property. Mark the tasks you completed and add short follow-up notes.
checklist.temporary: Checks and notes stay on this page only. They are not saved to your account or cloud and clear when you leave or refresh. Print a copy if you want to keep them. Avoid entering personal IDs or sensitive client details.
checklist.note_placeholder: Next step or document to follow up…
checklist.limit: Checking a task records your progress only; it does not verify a document or certify legal status.

items.reference: Confirm the property reference and map location
items.certificate: Request a current legal-status certificate through the Registry
items.review: Have the ownership and recorded entries reviewed by the appropriate professional
items.survey: Compare the survey, cadastral description and boundaries
items.permits: Check the intended use and applicable permits with the responsible authority
items.balances: Review available tax, association and utility balance information
items.rules: Review association rules, rental conditions and the proposed contract
items.followup: Record the professional review and remaining follow-up tasks
